# Changelog

## 0.2.0

### Added

- `perimeter`, a new free function. No existing signature changed.

### Changed

- `describe` now trims surrounding whitespace from its result. The signature is unchanged;
  this is a behaviour-only change.

## 0.1.0

### Added

- `Widget`, `Shape`, `describe`, the `extra` feature and `extra_only`, and `unix_only`.
- `Widget::create`, deprecated on arrival in favour of `Widget::new`.
